name: devcanon
description: User-wide CLI for managing shared AI skills and generating native Claude Code and Codex agent files from a single source of truth.

scripts.setup: git config core.hooksPath scripts/hooks && git config commit.template .gitmessage.txt
scripts.test:ci:windows:pr-review: vitest run --project unit --testTimeout 12000 --no-file-parallelism src/__test-helpers__/pr-review-command-harness.test.ts src/__test-helpers__/pr-review-process-protocol.test.ts src/__test-helpers__/pr-review-root-identity.test.ts src/__test-helpers__/pr-review-process-lifecycle.test.ts src/runtime/pr-review-leases.test.ts src/runtime/pr-review-manifests.test.ts src/runtime/source-immutability.test.ts --testNamePattern "PR-review command harness|pr-review process protocol|pr-review root identity|pr-review process lifecycle|(?:rejects stale or mismatched gated result evidence: (?:stale-timestamp|presentation-mismatch)|requires explicit provider evidence input for adapter scope validation|rejects noncanonical retained fingerprint path (?:\.\./outside|/absolute) before verify or cleanup deletion)$"
scripts.test:ci:windows: pnpm run test:unit:windows && pnpm run test:integration:render-install && pnpm run test:integration:windows
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run format:markdown:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:markdown && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:runtime && pnpm run test
